manifests.description: HELLS WRATH have appeared on the radar. They are catching up.
We have entered the 50+ Forgotten zone! But our lead at the top is slipping away.
"Our ally has secured some good POI causing them to grow like mushrooms." -- CiC
Pesky red dots have appeared, probably from Casino, to spy on us. But we move.
We have well and truly entered the satellite impact zone.
Shiion_NOD and ArabianKnight202 lays waste on Forgotten bases to secure a high value Reactor. We are back!
Wrath has stolen a march on us but not for long. Our power grows.
Our enemies have moved closer. CiC sounds the alarm to build up defense levels.
Two gigantic Tiberium POIs secured back to back. Our bases are growing at an unstoppable rate now.
BIG FUCKING REACTOR!!! We are unstoppable now!
Big reactor lost temporarily but eddi13131 and paladinstr8 team up to secure a Reactor-Tiberium double POI.
The enemy has gathered on both sides. War looms.
There is a lull as the enemy retreats temporarily to secure high-value POIs.
